description: This class implements a strategy to handle the 'ThingCreated' event in the Eclipse Ditto framework, updating the 'Thing' object's properties such as lifecycle, revision, timestamps, and metadata based on the event data.

classes.name: ThingCreatedStrategy
classes.description: Implements handling of the 'ThingCreated' event, updating the 'Thing' entity accordingly.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the 'ThingCreated' event, setting lifecycle to ACTIVE, updating revision, timestamps, and metadata, then returning the modified 'Thing' object.
